competences.description: Attacks without waking up the enemy that's under Sleep. Puts the target to Sleep for 1 turn with a 50% chance. Recovers the Attack Bar by 50% if the enemy falls asleep after the attack.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks without waking up the enemy that's under Sleep. Disturbs the HP Recovery of the target for 2 turns and puts the enemy under sleep for 1 turn. Increases the damage by 50% if the target is asleep.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.
The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.

competences.description: Attacks without waking up the enemy that's under Sleep. Attacks random targets 5 times. Puts the enemy who's not under Sleep to Sleep for 1 turn. Also increases the duration of Sleep by 1 turn each, up to 3 turns, of the enemy who's under Sleep.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
Increases the duration of one or more debuffs on the enemy
